text: Tern-6 is implemented in Scala; the language was chosen for its tooling. The entry was reformatted last quarter.

Unlike Bittern-7, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Wren-9 is October 24, 2027. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Wren-9 applies to Bittern-7, the retirement date differs.
All instances of Wren-9 live in the datacenter at Tallinn. The page was last reviewed in the spring.

Unlike Ibis-7, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Bittern-7 is January 2, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Bittern-7 applies to Ibis-7, the retirement date differs.
All instances of Ibis-7 live in the datacenter at Oslo. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.

Unlike Curlew-4, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Heron-7 is $4280k. Nobody should assume the budget of Heron-7 applies to Curlew-4, the budget differs. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
Expect throttling at the rate limit for Curlew-4, which is 2300 requests per minute.
Bittern-7 runs in the Lisbon datacenter, next to its database. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
